scope: Fixed London Set v5 adult consented-photo sample, local CPU research only. No broad accuracy or human-expert ground-truth claim.
license: CC BY 4.0, creator consent metadata verified by parent. No image pixels included in report or public artifacts.

criterion.poseCriterion: Exploratory box IoU only where creator eye labels are unavailable; no guessed eye points.
criterion.extraCandidates: Reported as unwanted. No threshold tuning or candidate/model substitution.
criterion.invalidBoxes: Rejected before useful-crop scoring; no clamping hides raw invalid geometry.

interpretation.poseRows: Exploratory stress photographs of repeated frontal subjects, not independent sample additions.
interpretation.annotations: Blinded assistant visual boxes and creator eye-center landmarks, not human-expert ground truth.
interpretation.preprocessing: Pillow RGB/BILINEAR is not verified browser canvas parity.
interpretation.timing: Node VM CPU only; not browser or phone speed.
interpretation.memory: TFJS logical live tensors after input disposal; not peak or process/native memory.

rows.interpolation: Pillow RGB conversion, resize BILINEAR, longest edge at most 1024, no EXIF rotation, no color-profile conversion

rows.interpolation: Pillow RGB conversion, resize BILINEAR, longest edge at most 1024, no EXIF rotation, no color-profile conversion

annotation.notes: Profile hides the far-side face; no hidden landmark guessed. Sideburns obscure part of temple; posterior cheek/ear-root and lower jaw limits are approximate. Profile crop IoU is exploratory only.
annotation.annotationMethod: Machine-assisted visual annotation after direct inspection of each original image, without accessing detector outputs.
annotation.boxConvention: Original-image pixel coordinates, origin at top left. Approximate visible forehead-to-chin rectangle spanning the visible face including nose and cheek. Outer hair, ears and neck excluded from intended extent; rectangular corners or the posterior cheek boundary may include incidental hair/ear-root pixels. No invisible face extent extrapolated.
